question: In a certain code language, 'BHAKTI' is coded as 'GSIZFA'. What is the code for 'BIKCER' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'BHAKTI' is coded as 'GSIZFA'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f2d2e9306f3c7fb86b19947173789ef2cd95f16b9aca79744ba814e7a0474ba.png] 

Similarly,

'BIKCER' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26d96c9c5fef69b80795446cc9a72e07e516d6e025e781d92dc167d69c89bbf4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PDAJGA".**
